purpose: Bounded routing index; source records are authoritative in the groups below

groups.scope: Current 16-section whitepaper v1.0, published conflicts, and refreshed token/charter pages; earlier baseline retained separately
Robinhood directory attribution, preferred Etherscan routing, dated frontend planning observations and prior explorer corroboration
Earlier same-day protocol, mint and whitepaper baseline; current whitepaper is routed through website-v1
Explainer variants, disclaimer, navigation discovery and profile status
Complete launch thread: root, mint terms, schedule and closing; trading continuations in launch-trading
Launch thread trading-tax and day-one activation continuations
Audit-round and report promises; publisher claims, not reviewed audit reports
Superseded free-genesis terms, allocation waves, whitepaper release and early launch messaging
Complete recovered monetary-policy thread including official continuations and closing image
Attributed third-party replies and reposted opinion, excluded from protocol facts

lookup: Match a source ID to groups.record_ids and read that literal package-root-relative path. The index does not duplicate authoritative records.
rules: Publication time, claimed event time, retrieval time, review depth and claim stage are independent
Original URLs identify statements even when retrieved via a mirror; mirrors are not independent corroboration
Source-specific numeric parameter values live in assets/parameters.json, not this index
Coverage is bounded by the recorded discovery/retrieval scope; a stopped feed is not a complete account archive
No scanner history, native-host transcripts or review verdicts belong in this source catalog
